hero.title: Undergraduate Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A **Bachelor’s in Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** can be a pathway for students interested in designing, building and improving systems, machines, infrastructure and technology. Engineering programmes in Mauritius include chemical, civil, mechanical, electrical and electronic, mechatronics, telecommunications and industrial engineering. Students planning to **study Engineering in Mauritius** can explore different specialisations based on their academic interests and career goals.

highlights.title: Bilingual & English Degrees
highlights.desc: Study in English with recognized qualifications from national institutions and global UK/Australian branch campuses.

highlights.desc: Streamlined student visa procedures arranged directly through recognized higher education institutions.

overview: The University of Mauritius lists several four-year Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) programmes for the 2026–2027 academic year. The Université des Mascareignes also offers engineering programmes, including a four-year BEng pathway. These **Engineering Universities in Mauritius** provide options for students considering undergraduate engineering education abroad.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Undergraduate Engineering in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Undergraduate Engineering in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Undergraduate Engineering in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
